# Uniaxial cyclic tensile test of a cube (example ex1 of mfem-mgis-examples,
# whose sources are installed by mfem-mgis: plasticity with linear isotropic
# hardening), with its behaviour generated by the generic-parallel
# interface. The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its
# build directory, the behaviour library being given by its option -l; the
# mode of integration and the device are given by the environment variables
# of mfem-mgis (the example has no --device option).
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/../mfem-mgis-examples/ex1"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex1 of mfem-mgis-examples")

# tests of the example on one process, the gradient, the thermodynamic
# force and the equivalent plastic strain of each time step being compared
# to the reference values of the example, point by point (generic library
# of the example), all the computations by kernels with the generic library
# and by batches with each backend
if(EXISTS "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR}/uniaxial_tensile_test")
  add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex1-behaviours CUDA
    "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR}/IsotropicLinearHardeningPlasticity.mfront")
  set(_run ./uniaxial_tensile_test --no-post-processing
           --reference-file IsotropicLinearHardeningPlasticity.ref)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  add_test(NAME ex1-point-par-point COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ex1-noyaux COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ex1-point-par-point PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
  set_tests_properties(ex1-noyaux PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;${_kernels}")
  set(_tests ex1-point-par-point ex1-noyaux)
  foreach(_backend ${ex1-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
    add_test(NAME ex1-batch-${_backend} COMMAND ${_run} -l "${_library}"
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX1_DIR}")
    list(APPEND _tests ex1-batch-${_backend})
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      set_tests_properties(ex1-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_DEVICE=cuda;${_kernels}"
        RESOURCE_LOCK gpu)
    else()
      set_tests_properties(ex1-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=2;${_kernels}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  # all the tests write the results of each step in the same file of the
  # build directory of the example
  set_tests_properties(${_tests} PROPERTIES RESOURCE_LOCK ex1-outputs)
  if(TEST ex1-batch-cuda)
    set_tests_properties(ex1-batch-cuda PROPERTIES
      RESOURCE_LOCK "gpu;ex1-outputs")
  endif()
endif()
